## Live introductory event

31 st October 2025 2-3pm: **Sydney Research Cloud: Pawsey Information Session** (online) 
 
The session will cover: 

- An overview of the research computing landscape at The University of Sydney, including the new initiative offering compute hours on Setonix 
- An introduction to Pawsey Supercomputing Research Centre and its national services 
- How to become an early adopter via our Expression of Interest (EOI) process
